parameters: Two thousand of the Crown's soldiers wind into the
Grauklamm: a gorge of grey rock and old snow that runs
west from the Wall to the valley of Weißenfels.
Rin rides at the head of the column with her knight
captain. The three of you walk with the rearguard, where
Takamura Sōma, captain of Her Highness's knights. You're
the Guild strays the Marshal lent us.
Hm. Her Highness trusts you. I trust Her Highness. Keep
up, keep your eyes on the ridges, and if something comes
down on the column, kill it.
A pleasant man. I had forty like him once.
…Weißenfels is at the end of this. I walked out of it,

parameters.desc: The army marches west through the Grauklamm. The royal camp is at its far end, in sight of Weißenfels.

My boots are full of the Grauklamm. My brother's are
full of Weißenfels. Six years. I'll bring them home.
They say the forge in the city never goes out. You can
see its glow on the clouds at night. Like a wound.
It took Hayashi. Picked him up like a lamb. Gods…
Shrieks from the ridge. Two shapes fold their wings and
drop onto the column like stones: long necks, barbed
tails, and the stink of a carrion nest.
Wyverns! Get the wounded behind me!
Rank D, my Lord, the same as us now. Mind the tails:
…That was quick work. Hayashi's gone. Two more hurt.
Wyverns don't hunt this far south in pairs. Something
on the other end of this gorge is sending its dogs.
Then we'll go and meet it. Column, march!
A grateful sergeant presses an Elixier on you.

Three people huddle in the snow at the side of the road,
in the blue coats of Weißenfels. They don't look up.
…Help us. We got out. We got out of the city.
My Lord. Look at the snow around them.
And there's no breath in the cold air. Whatever they
The three stand up together, too smoothly. Their eyes
have gone the colour of old blood.
They're wearing Weißenfels blue. Their own blue.
…Someone in that city is making thralls out of the
And sends them out along the road to meet the ones
who come looking. We should tell the princess.
